summary:
## Standing operator rules
Never enable a new Celery task in `ledgerly/tasks/` unless `perf/locust_tasks.py` demonstrates at least 400 successful task executions per second with zero timeout failures.

Never edit tests/conftest.py without posting the proposed diff in #ledgerly-tests and waiting for @mira to approve it.

Keep commits small so review stays easy.

The ci-runner-small pool is being retired and jobs there hang; integration jobs must target ci-runner-arm64 from now on.

## Current objective
Fix `ledgerly/dunning/scheduler.py` so the dunning email scheduler does not send reminders to customers who already paid. The router split and Elasticsearch reindex procedure are paused.

## Ruled-out approaches
Pop pending events before persistence: failed persistence then loses retryable work.

Store shared incoming batch objects directly: aliasing retained charged events.

Retain `_last_batch`: it defeats cleanup.

Wrap webhook handlers in a retry decorator with 5 attempts: it re-sent customer emails multiple times.

Retrying HTTP 4xx responses: they must fail immediately.

## Recent work
Implemented bounded webhook retries for transport and retryable server errors; added validation, backoff, and tests. All 44 tests and Ruff pass. Search indexing baseline has 18 passing and 2 failing tests; rebuilds appear to serialize embeddings one page at a time, but this work is paused.
